_readme: MUFF-57 manual ingestion template (degraded mode while the Yahoo API is blocked).
Copy to fixtures/weekly/<season>-wNN.json, fill every null, then run:
npm run fixture:validate fixtures/weekly/<season>-wNN.json -- --prev fixtures/weekly/<last week>.json
Keys starting with _ are hints and are ignored by the validator. Click-order checklist: docs/ingestion-checklist.md.
Type only what Yahoo SHOWS. Margins, superlatives, deltas and the start/sit verdict are computed in code.
Then upload: HISTORY_BUCKET=<bucket> npm run fixture:upload fixtures/weekly/<season>-wNN.json (validates again, stamps ingested_at, refuses on any error).

source._source.ingested_by: Your name. ingested_at is stamped by `npm run fixture:upload` (MUFF-58) — leave it null.

_source.league: Yahoo → league home → title bar (league name).
_source.week: The week being recapped (last completed week), not Yahoo's current week.

matchups._source: Yahoo → League → Scoreboard → pick Week N. One block per matchup (6 for 12 teams). Team names EXACTLY as Yahoo shows them.

teams._source.points: Final team total on the scoreboard card, 2 decimals.
teams._source.projected: Yahoo's projected total if still shown; null if not.

standings._source: Yahoo → League → Standings. One row per team, top to bottom. 12 rows for 12 teams.
standings._source.manager: Optional first name (team page or the league's manager list). Used for the personal touch.
standings._source.record: The W-L-T column, split into three integers.
standings._source.points_for: The Pts For column (season total, 2 decimals).
standings._source.streak: The Streak column as shown, e.g. "W2" / "L1"; null if blank.

transactions._source: Yahoo → League → Transactions, newest first, since last Tuesday. Up to 5 is plenty. Leave the array empty ([]) for a quiet week.
transactions._source.type: One of: add, drop, add/drop, trade, commish.

players._source.from_to: Team name, "FA" (free agents) or "W" (waivers). Null if the row doesn't say.

bench_points._source: OPTIONAL. Yahoo → Scoreboard → open a matchup → bench section: sum each team's bench points. Do all teams or none.

start_sit._source: OPTIONAL. While on the matchup page: a benched player who outscored a starter he could have replaced (position must fit the slot). Delta and would-it-have-flipped are computed.
start_sit._source.slot: The starter's lineup slot as Yahoo labels it: QB, WR, RB, TE, W/R/T, K, DEF.
